summary: SPEC-13 needs room sizes, the ship's interior grid and per-level room limits from real data before the placement check can be written. The read-only capture step now also records ListRoomDesigns2 and the ShipDesigns and RoomDesignPurchases parts of ListAllDesigns4, sanitized and scanned like every other capture. Both calls are read-only in the capability inventory, ListAllDesigns4 runs once per account, and a failed design read is reported by name. No workflow change: the owner's next step=capture run picks them up. The real-client capture test now serves the two endpoints and checks that only allow-listed read-only paths are called.

contract_status_changes.contract: Capture room designs, ship designs and room purchase limits read-only
contract_status_changes.after: capture step records the three design lists
proof: tests: design captures keep game-data ids and grid fields, purchase ids are replaced, ListAllDesigns4 runs once per account, a failed design read is named; real Client against a fake adapter calls only allow-listed read-only paths
make syntax-check, make test (1316 OK), make lint, git diff --check pass

residual_risks: Live design records may be withheld by the scan if a field looks secret-like; the capture report says so.
